metadata.description: Claude Code mods by Dave Kiss

plugins.name: leaks
plugins.description: Find where your Claude Code week went and fix it: /leaks ranks the avoidable spend in your transcripts with one-press fixes, and a strip above the prompt flags a leak while it happens.

plugins.name: shot
plugins.description: Headless macOS screenshots for agents: capture, mark up, redact, record and find screenshots without taking focus. Bundles the shot MCP server, a skill, /shot and a history pane.

plugins.name: env
plugins.description: Edit .env files in a pane inside Claude Code. Claude manages keys and asks you for values without ever seeing them.

plugins.name: md
plugins.description: Read, write and review markdown with Claude in a pane inside Claude Code: drafts stream in, comments stay on their words, and Claude suggests edits you accept or reject.

plugins.name: burn
plugins.description: Burn one-word-at-a-time captions into a video: local transcription, a real proofread, and a check of the finished render. Needs the burn CLI.

plugins.name: agentcam
plugins.description: Record, drive, and export demo videos of terminal programs and X11 apps with the agentcam CLI.
